Container.Name: Rewindarr
Container.Overview: A rewind for your media server, inspired by Spotify Wrapped. Present Plex and Jellyfin user statistics and habits using data from Tautulli or Tracearr (Jellyfin through Tracearr), with an optional Seerr integration. Formerly Plex Rewind.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex rewind jellyfin tautulli tracearr wrapped statistics
Container.Changes:
### 2026-10-31
Plex Rewind is now Rewindarr: switch to the ghcr.io/raunot/rewindarr image, update links and icon, add PUID and PGID, remove the unused All-Time Start Date variable
### 2024-08-20
Remove requirement for pre-boot settings file, change Settings Path to Config Path
### 2024-07-25
Change Config Path to direct "settings.json" path
### 2024-07-16
Initial release
